parts.title: Meeting the team
parts.md:
Claire introduces Nam to the team. **Tom talks quickly** – perfect practice.

**4 rounds, normal speed, no answers:**
1. 👀👂 **Listen + read together** (the words are open below). Follow with your eyes.
2. 📝 **Read the notes** below the player – one line at a time.
3. 👀👂 **Listen + read again.** It will feel easier.
4. 👂 **Hide the transcript** and listen once more. If you miss a word – keep going.

#### Notes – line by line
| Line | What it means |
|---|---|
| *He's starting today.* | **He's** = he is. Today is his first day. |
| *How's it going **so far**?* | How are you, until now? – friendly small talk |
| *So far so good.* | Everything is OK until now. |
| ***Although** I got a bit wet* | a small surprise or problem: it rained on him (🇻🇳 *mặc dù*) |
| *You'll **get used to** it.* | **You'll** = you will. It will become normal for you. |
| *I've lived here ten years* | **I've** = I have. He came 10 years ago and still lives here. |
| *could you **show Nam around**?* | walk with Nam and show him the office |
| *that kind of thing* | and similar things |
| *just **let me know*** | just tell me |
| *It **takes a while** to **get the hang of** everything* | you need some time to learn how everything works (🇻🇳 *quen tay*) |
| ***by the way*** | a new small question |
| *The coffee machine is terrible, **though**.* | **though** at the end = but / however |
| *Most of us go to the café downstairs **instead**.* | not the machine → the café |

listen.text: So, Nam, this is the team. Everyone, this is Nam. He's starting today.
Hi, Nam! Nice to meet you. How's it going so far?
Hi, nice to meet you too. So far so good, thanks. Although I got a bit wet on the way here.
Ha! Welcome to Manchester. You'll get used to it. I've lived here ten years and I still forget my umbrella.
Tom, could you show Nam around after lunch? The kitchen, the printer, that kind of thing.
Sure, no problem. And Nam, if you need anything, just let me know. It takes a while to get the hang of everything here.
Thanks, that's really kind. Where's the kitchen, by the way? I'd love another coffee.
Come on, I'll show you now. The coffee machine is terrible, though. Most of us go to the café downstairs instead.

parts.title: How was it?
parts.md: No quiz. Tell me how much you understood – and ask me anything in the box below. Then 📤 **Submit** and go to the next small lesson.
